messages.content: You write short, plain descriptions of database objects for people who are not engineers, from disclosed metadata only: names, column names, keys and SQL with literal values hidden. You never see row values or statistics. Say what each object is or does in one or two sentences, in sentence case, without jargon or a list of tables. Respond with a single JSON object.

response.content: {"descriptions":[{"name":"dbo.X_V_DEPT_CENSUS","text":"Shows department census counts by snapshot date. It is for reviewing census levels across departments over time."},{"name":"dbo.fn_X_PATIENT_STAYS","text":"Returns a patient’s encounters and their admission and discharge times within a requested date range. It is for reviewing that patient’s stays."},{"name":"dbo.rpt_X_ENCOUNTERS_BY_DEPT","text":"Counts encounters by department for a requested date range. It is for comparing encounter volume across departments."},{"name":"dbo.usp_X_ARCHIVE_CENSUS","text":"Moves census snapshots older than a specified date into an archive and removes them from the current snapshot records. It is for keeping older census records separate."},{"name":"dbo.usp_X_CHECK_CENSUS","text":"Counts census records with negative values. It is for checking census data for potential problems."},{"name":"dbo.usp_X_LOAD_READMIT_FLAGS","text":"Refreshes readmission flags based on whether a patient has another admission within the specified number of days after discharge, and records the job run. It is for identifying possible readmissions."}]}
